entries.title: Psalms 62:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.>> Truly my soul silently [waits] for God; From Him [comes] my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 62:2
segments: He only [is] my rock and my salvation; [He is] my defense; I shall not be greatly moved.

entries.title: Psalms 62:3
segments: How long will you attack a man? You shall be slain, all of you, Like a leaning wall and a tottering fence.

entries.title: Psalms 62:4
segments: They only consult to cast [him] down from his high position; They delight in lies; They bless with their mouth, But they curse inwardly. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 62:5
segments: My soul, wait silently for God alone, For my expectation [is] from Him.

entries.title: Psalms 62:6
segments: He only [is] my rock and my salvation; [He is] my defense; I shall not be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 62:7
segments: In God [is] my salvation and my glory; The rock of my strength, [And] my refuge, [is] in God.

entries.title: Psalms 62:8
segments: ¶Trust in Him at all times, you people; Pour out your heart before Him; God [is] a refuge for us. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 62:9
segments: Surely men of low degree [are] a vapor, Men of high degree [are] a lie; If they are weighed on the scales, They [are] altogether [lighter] than vapor.

entries.title: Psalms 62:10
segments: Do not trust in oppression, Nor vainly hope in robbery; If riches increase, Do not set [your] heart [on them].

entries.title: Psalms 62:11
segments: God has spoken once, Twice I have heard this: That power [belongs] to God.

entries.title: Psalms 62:12
segments: Also to You, O Lord, [belongs] mercy; For You render to each one according to his work.
